title: Grateful Dead Live at Rainbow Theater on 1981-10-06
lineage: Cassette > Nakamichi CD1 > Tascam DR-100mkII > wav 24/176.4; Lineage: wav 24/176.4 > Adobe Audition CC > iZotope RX5 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > iZotope RX5 Advanced wav 16.44.1 > CD Wave >TLH > Flac 24; transferred, edited and mastered SIRMick April 2017
source: Audience recording > Sony ECM-99 > JVC CD-1635 > Master Cassettes (C90 Maxell UD XLII x 3); Taped by Peter Williams from middle of stalls, just right of centre and about 1/3 back from front of stage;

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience transfer captures a high‑energy show with standout renditions of Shakedown Street, Althea, Looks Like Rain and Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The SIRmick transfer is praised as flawless and crystal‑clear, delivering an enjoyable listening experience. The concert never lets up – from a rousing Shakedown Street opener through brilliant Althea, rain‑kissed Looks Like Rain, a soaring Stella Blue and an electrifying Daydream, capped by two powerful Jerry solos.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review overwhelmingly positive about both performance and sound quality; weighted heavily toward show excellence with an excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the transfer "awesome" and notes no issues – clear, well‑balanced audio that faithfully captures the energy of the night.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high‑energy flow from start to finish, with smooth transitions and a powerful two‑solo close that leaves the audience buzzing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for beautiful 'raindrop' notes on Looks Like Rain and two soaring solos at the end.
band_member_comments.Bob: Described as "bobby" with great energy, ready to drive the next sets.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland highlighted for being in awesome form throughout the show.
